question: calculate 2023 ANC coverage rate minus 2021 rate in percentage points for Gaya and Nalanda
gold_sql: WITH rates AS (SELECT district, year, 100.0 * anc4_completed / pregnancies_registered AS rate FROM anc_visits WHERE district IN ('Gaya', 'Nalanda') AND year IN (2021, 2023)) SELECT district, ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN year = 2023 THEN rate END) - MAX(CASE WHEN year = 2021 THEN rate END), 1) AS change_pp FROM rates GROUP BY district ORDER BY district
sql_duckdb: SELECT district, (SUM(CASE WHEN year = 2023 THEN anc4_completed END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN year = 2023 THEN pregnancies_registered END), 0), 0)) - (SUM(CASE WHEN year = 2021 THEN anc4_completed END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN year = 2021 THEN pregnancies_registered END), 0), 0)) AS anc_coverage_pp_change FROM anc_visits WHERE district IN ('Gaya', 'Nalanda') AND year IN (2021, 2023) GROUP BY district

CURRENT QUESTION:
calculate 2023 ANC coverage rate minus 2021 rate in percentage points for Gaya and Nalanda
attempts.response:
```sql
SELECT
  district,
  (
    SUM(CASE WHEN year = 2023 THEN anc4_completed END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN year = 2023 THEN pregnancies_registered END), 0)
  ) - (
    SUM(CASE WHEN year = 2021 THEN anc4_completed END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN year = 2021 THEN pregnancies_registered END), 0)
  ) AS anc_coverage_pp_change
FROM anc_visits
WHERE
  district IN ('Gaya', 'Nalanda')
  AND year IN (2021, 2023)
GROUP BY
  district;
```
